name: Shanghu breach: Yellow River turns north
summary: The Yellow River broke through at Shanghu (Puyang) and swung north to reach the sea near Tianjin, flooding Hebei and sending hundreds of thousands of refugees south.
summary_zh: 黄河在澶州商胡埽决口，改道北流至天津一带入海，河北大水，流民数十万南下。

name: Xining drought and the Refugee Scroll
summary: A long drought and locusts drove refugees toward Kaifeng; Zheng Xia's painting of starving migrants reached Emperor Shenzong and helped force Wang Anshi's first dismissal.
summary_zh: 连年大旱兼蝗灾，流民涌向开封；郑侠绘《流民图》上呈神宗，促成王安石第一次罢相。

name: Lake Tai freezes over
summary: In the winter of 1111 Lake Tai froze hard enough to walk on and the Dongting citrus groves died, a marker of the twelfth-century cold phase that historians link to northern nomad pressure.
summary_zh: 政和元年冬太湖结冰可行人，洞庭山柑橘尽冻死，是十二世纪寒冷期的标志之一。

name: Du Chong breaches the Yellow River
area: Henan, Shandong and the Huai plain
toll_zh: 一般估计溺死二十万人以上
summary: To block the advancing Jurchen, the Song commander Du Chong cut the Yellow River dikes near Huazhou; the river began draining southeast through the Si and Huai, the start of 700 years of Huai-basin flooding.
summary_zh: 南宋东京留守杜充为阻金兵，在滑州附近决黄河，河水东南经泗水入淮，开启黄河夺淮的七百年。

name: Zhedong drought and Zhu Xi's relief
summary: Drought and famine in eastern Zhejiang led the court to send Zhu Xi as relief commissioner; his impeachment of local officials and promotion of community granaries made famine relief a Neo-Confucian cause.
summary_zh: 浙东旱饥，朝廷派朱熹提举浙东常平茶盐公事救荒；他弹劾贪吏、推广社仓，使荒政成为理学关怀。

name: Yangwu breach: Yellow River captures the Huai
summary: Under the Jin, the river broke at Yangwu and flowed southeast into the Huai, a course that lasted until 1855 and wrecked the drainage of the Huai plain.
summary_zh: 金明昌五年黄河在阳武决口，东南夺淮入海，此道延续至1855年，淮北水系从此紊乱。

name: Epidemic in besieged Kaifeng
toll_zh: 《金史》称五十日出死者九十余万（或有夸大）
summary: During the Mongol siege of the Jin capital an epidemic swept the city; the Jin history reports some 900,000 coffins carried out in fifty days, and the dynasty fell two years later.
summary_zh: 蒙古围攻金都汴京期间城中大疫，《金史》称五十日间出城死者九十余万，两年后金亡。

name: Mongols flood the Song advance
summary: When Song armies marched to retake Kaifeng and Luoyang after the fall of Jin, the Mongols broke the Yellow River dikes north of Kaifeng, flooding the Song line of advance and helping wreck the campaign.
summary_zh: 端平入洛时，蒙古军在开封北寸金淀决黄河灌宋军，宋军进退失据而溃。

name: Sickness in the Mongol camp at Diaoyu
summary: Summer heat and disease struck Möngke's army besieging Diaoyu Fortress; the Great Khan died there, whether of illness or wounds, halting the conquest of Song and triggering the Kublai–Ariq Böke war.
summary_zh: 蒙哥围攻钓鱼城，暑热疾疫流行，蒙哥死于军中（病死或伤死说法不一），攻宋中止并引发汗位之争。

name: Wuping earthquake
area_zh: 武平路（今内蒙古宁城一带）
toll_zh: 传统记载约十万人死亡
summary: A strong earthquake shook Wuping circuit north of Dadu, flattening towns and killing many in the region around Huizhou and Daning.
summary_zh: 大都以北武平路强震，城郭庐舍多毁，死伤甚众。

name: Hongdong earthquake
toll_zh: 估计死亡二十万至四十七万余人
summary: A great earthquake struck Pingyang and Taiyuan circuits in Shanxi, one of the deadliest in Chinese history; aftershocks and relief burdens lasted years.
summary_zh: 山西平阳、太原路大地震，为中国历史上最惨烈的地震之一，余震与赈济持续数年。

name: Epidemics of the early 1330s
area: Hebei and the North China Plain
summary: Yuan annals record mass deaths from epidemic, drought and flood in Hebei and elsewhere; some historians have linked these outbreaks to the origins of the Black Death, though the connection is debated.
summary_zh: 元代史籍载河北等地疫病、旱涝致大量死亡；有学者将其与黑死病起源相联系，但尚存争议。

name: Drought, locusts and plague in Huaibei
summary: Drought, locusts and epidemic killed Zhu Yuanzhang's parents and elder brother within weeks; the orphan became a monk-beggar and later joined the Red Turbans, eventually founding the Ming.
summary_zh: 濠州旱蝗大疫，朱元璋父母兄长相继病饿而死；他出家为僧、行乞四方，后投红巾军，终建明朝。

name: Baimao breach and Jia Lu's river works
summary: The Yellow River burst at Baimao and flooded Shandong and Henan for seven years, ruining the Grand Canal and salt works; Jia Lu's 1351 levy of some 170,000 labourers to close it gave the Red Turbans their rallying ground.
summary_zh: 黄河白茅堤决口，山东、河南泛滥七年，运河盐场受损；1351年贾鲁征发十七万民夫堵口，“石人一只眼”谶语遂引发红巾起义。

name: Famine and epidemic at Dadu
toll_zh: 《元史》载京城周围收埋尸骨约二十万
summary: With the Grand Canal and sea grain route cut by rebels, famine and plague struck the Yuan capital; the eunuch Pak Bulhwa had about 200,000 corpses buried outside the city walls.
summary_zh: 红巾军与张士诚等割断漕运与海运，大都饥疫交加，宦官朴不花于城外收埋尸骨约二十万具。

name: Xinxiang breach and Shawan canal crisis
summary: The Yellow River broke near Xinxiang and swept northeast into the Grand Canal at Shawan, threatening grain shipments to Beijing just as the Tumu crisis struck; Xu Youzhen closed the breach in 1455.
summary_zh: 黄河在新乡八柳树决口，东北冲入运河沙湾，危及京师漕运，又逢土木之变；1455年徐有贞治河堵口。

name: Great snows of the Jingtai winter
toll: Tens of thousands reported frozen to death
toll_zh: 冻死者以万计
summary: Weeks of heavy snow buried the Huai and lower Yangtze; the Huai froze, the sea ice extended dozens of li from the coast, and large numbers of people and livestock froze to death.
summary_zh: 景泰四年冬至次春，江淮大雪数尺，淮河封冻，沿海结冰四十余里，人畜冻死甚众。

name: Chenghua drought in the northwest
toll: Shaanxi alone reported 'millions' displaced or dead
toll_zh: 陕西一省流亡死者以百万计
summary: Three years of drought produced famine with reports of cannibalism across Shaanxi, Shanxi and Henan; millions fled, adding to the floating population of the Jingxiang hills.
summary_zh: 陕、晋、豫连年大旱，“人相食”，流民数百万，荆襄山区流民问题加剧。

name: Zhangqiu breach and Liu Daxia's dike
summary: Repeated breaches culminating at Zhangqiu cut the Grand Canal; Liu Daxia closed the gap and built the Taihang dike, pushing the river permanently south into the Huai to protect the canal.
summary_zh: 黄河屡决，终于张秋冲断运河；刘大夏堵口并筑太行堤，使黄河全流南下夺淮以保漕运。

name: Jiajing drought in the north
summary: Drought and famine struck the north in the early Jiajing reign; Lin Xi's 'Famine Relief Memorial' with illustrations became a classic of Ming relief administration.
summary_zh: 嘉靖初北方大旱饥荒，林希元上《荒政丛言》，成为明代荒政名篇。

name: Jiajing Huaxian earthquake
toll_zh: 明代记载约八十三万人死亡
summary: The deadliest recorded earthquake in history collapsed the loess cave dwellings of the Wei valley; the disaster deepened the fiscal strain of the Jiajing court.
summary_zh: 嘉靖三十四年末渭河谷地大地震，窑洞成片坍塌，为有记载以来死亡最多的地震。

name: Gaojiayan breach and the Huai floods
summary: The Huai broke through the Gaojiayan dike and the Yellow River silted the canal at Qingkou, flooding Huai'an and Yangzhou; Zhang Juzheng appointed Pan Jixun, whose 'confine the river to scour the silt' policy shaped river control for centuries.
summary_zh: 淮决高家堰、黄河淤塞清口，淮扬一片汪洋；张居正起用潘季驯，“束水攻沙”之法影响治河数百年。

name: Wanli drought and epidemic
area: North China and the Yangtze delta
summary: Successive droughts and an epidemic (possibly plague) swept Shanxi, Hebei, Henan and Jiangnan in the late 1580s; famine relief drained the treasury that Zhang Juzheng had built up.
summary_zh: 万历十五至十七年南北连旱，山西、北直隶、河南及江南疫疠流行，赈济耗尽张居正积累的国库。

name: Shandong famine
summary: Drought and locusts in Shandong brought famine with reports of cannibalism, while Wanli's mining tax eunuchs kept squeezing the province; unrest grew on the eve of the Manchu war.
summary_zh: 山东旱蝗大饥，人相食，而矿监税使仍横征暴敛，民变迭起，正值后金崛起前夜。

name: Chongzhen megadrought
toll: Millions dead; North China population fell sharply
toll_zh: 死亡以百万计，北方人口锐减
summary: The worst drought in five centuries, amid the coldest phase of the Little Ice Age, ruined North China; famine fed the Shaanxi revolts that grew into Li Zicheng's and Zhang Xianzhong's armies and brought down the Ming.
summary_zh: 小冰期最冷阶段遭遇五百年来最严重的干旱，北方赤地千里；饥民蜂起，发展为李自成、张献忠大军，终致明亡。

name: Late-Ming locust plagues
summary: Locust swarms followed the drought across Henan, Shandong, Hebei and into Jiangnan, stripping fields bare; in Henan the hungry joined Li Zicheng, who took Luoyang in 1641 with the slogan of grain and no taxes.
summary_zh: 大旱之后飞蝗遍及豫、鲁、冀并南至江南，禾稼尽食；河南饥民纷纷投奔李自成，1641年破洛阳，“迎闯王，不纳粮”。

name: Jiangnan famine of the Chongzhen years
summary: Drought, locusts and then flood struck even the rich Yangtze delta, where rice prices rose several-fold and urban riots broke out, undercutting the Ming's last fiscal base.
summary_zh: 崇祯十三、十四年江南亦旱蝗相继，米价数倍上涨，城市抢米风潮迭起，明朝最后的财源动摇。

name: North China plague
toll: Beijing reportedly lost a fifth or more of its population in 1643
toll_zh: 1643年京师人口据称死亡五分之一以上
summary: An epidemic, probably plague, spread from Shanxi across the north; in 1643 it killed a large share of Beijing's people and garrison, leaving the capital nearly defenceless when Li Zicheng arrived.
summary_zh: 疫病（多认为是鼠疫）自山西蔓延华北，1643年京师死者无数、守军减员，次年李自成兵临城下几无抵抗。

name: Drowning of Kaifeng
toll_zh: 城中约三十七万人中约三十万死亡
summary: During Li Zicheng's third siege the Yellow River dikes were cut (each side blamed the other) and the river poured into the starving city, drowning most of its people.
summary_zh: 李自成第三次围攻开封时黄河大堤被决（双方互相指责），洪水灌城，城中饥民大多溺死。

name: Shunzhi frost
summary: In one of the bitterest winters of the Little Ice Age, Lake Tai and the Han and Huai rivers froze and the Jiangxi and Zhejiang orange groves were killed, while the Qing still fought the Southern Ming.
summary_zh: 小冰期最严寒的冬季之一，太湖、汉水、淮河封冻，江西、浙江柑橘尽数冻死，时清军仍与南明交战。

name: Tancheng earthquake
toll_zh: 约五万人死亡
summary: One of the largest earthquakes in eastern China (magnitude ~8.5) devastated Tancheng and Juzhou; it became famous through Jonathan Spence's 'The Death of Woman Wang'.
summary_zh: 郯城、莒州一带发生约8.5级强震，为中国东部最大地震之一，史景迁《王氏之死》即以此为背景。

name: Kangxi great freeze
summary: The Han and Huai rivers froze and heavy snow lay for weeks across central China; repeated hard winters of the 1670s coincided with the strains of the Three Feudatories war.
summary_zh: 汉水、淮河封冻，华中积雪经月；1670年代屡遇严冬，适逢三藩之乱的压力。

name: Sanhe–Pinggu earthquake
toll_zh: 约四万五千人死亡
summary: A magnitude ~8 earthquake east of Beijing damaged the Forbidden City in the midst of the Three Feudatories war; the Kangxi Emperor issued an edict of self-reproach and ordered relief.
summary_zh: 京东三河、平谷约8级大地震，紫禁城受损，正值三藩之乱；康熙帝下罪己诏，发帑赈济。

name: Sizhou city sinks beneath Hongze Lake
summary: Silt from the Yellow River backed up the Huai until floods drowned the prefectural city of Sizhou and the Ming ancestral tombs; Kangxi made river works one of his three great concerns and inspected them on his southern tours.
summary_zh: 黄河泥沙抬高淮河，洪泽湖扩张淹没泗州城及明祖陵；康熙将河务列为三大事之一，南巡亲阅河工。

name: Linfen earthquake
toll_zh: 约五万人死亡（估计）
summary: A magnitude ~8 earthquake struck Pingyang (Linfen), destroying much of the city and surrounding counties.
summary_zh: 山西平阳府（临汾）约8级地震，府城及周边州县大半倾圮。

name: Zhili drought and Qianlong's relief
toll: Relief to ~2 million people; mortality kept low
toll_zh: 赈济约二百万口，死亡较少
summary: A severe drought in Zhili was met by one of the largest relief operations of the High Qing, with granary grain distributed to some two million people, a model of the eighteenth-century famine state.
summary_zh: 直隶大旱，清廷开仓赈济约二百万人，成为盛清荒政的典范。

name: Qianlong drought
area: North China Plain, Huai and lower Yangtze
summary: Widespread drought and famine in Shandong, Henan, Jiangsu and Anhui exposed failing granaries and corruption under Heshen; the hill regions that absorbed the refugees soon rose in the White Lotus rebellion.
summary_zh: 鲁、豫、苏、皖大旱饥荒，暴露和珅当政下仓储空虚与吏治腐败；接纳流民的山区不久爆发白莲教起义。

name: Kangding earthquake and Dadu River flood
toll_zh: 洪水据称致约十万人死亡
summary: An earthquake near Kangding triggered a landslide that dammed the Dadu River; when the dam burst ten days later the flood swept hundreds of kilometres downstream.
summary_zh: 康定附近地震引发山崩堵塞大渡河，十日后堰塞湖溃决，洪水下泻数百公里。

name: Jiaqing flood of the capital region
summary: Torrential summer rains broke the Yongding River dikes and flooded Beijing and surrounding Zhili; the newly empowered Jiaqing Emperor organised large-scale relief and soup kitchens.
summary_zh: 夏季暴雨，永定河决口，京城与直隶多地被淹；亲政不久的嘉庆帝大规模开厂施粥赈济。

name: Drought of 1813 and the Eight Trigrams
area: Northern Henan, southern Zhili, western Shandong
summary: Drought and soaring grain prices in the Henan–Zhili–Shandong border region swelled the Eight Trigrams sect, whose rebels attacked the Forbidden City that autumn.
summary_zh: 豫、直、鲁交界大旱，粮价飞涨，天理教（八卦教）乘势聚众，当年秋攻入紫禁城。

name: Tambora cold and the Yunnan famine
summary: After the eruption of Mount Tambora, three cold summers ruined Yunnan's rice crops; the poet Li Yuyang described the famine, and the crisis pushed farmers toward opium poppy as a hardier cash crop.
summary_zh: 坦博拉火山爆发后云南连续三年夏季低温，稻谷失收，诗人李于阳记其惨状；危机促使农民改种更耐寒的罂粟。

name: Daoguang flood
summary: Prolonged rains flooded the Yangtze delta, the Huai and Zhili at once; the cost of relief and of the decaying Grand Canal pushed the court to experiment with shipping tribute grain by sea in 1826.
summary_zh: 淫雨连月，江南、江淮与直隶同时大水；赈灾与运河淤废之困，促使清廷于1826年试行漕粮海运。

name: Yellow River breaches at Kaifeng and Zhongmou
summary: During the Opium War the Yellow River broke at Xiangfu, besieging Kaifeng with water for months, then at Zhongmou in 1843; the cost of repairs drained a treasury already paying the British indemnity.
summary_zh: 鸦片战争期间黄河在祥符决口，开封被水围困数月，1843年又决中牟；巨额河工与对英赔款同时掏空国库。

name: Yangtze flood of 1849
summary: Catastrophic floods along the middle and lower Yangtze created vast numbers of refugees just before the Taiping uprising; famine in Guangxi and Hunan in 1849–50 fed the rebel ranks.
summary_zh: 长江中下游特大水灾，流民遍野；1849—1850年广西、湖南亦饥，为太平天国起义提供了兵源。

name: Tongwaxiang breach: Yellow River turns north
summary: With the dynasty absorbed by the Taiping war, the river broke at Tongwaxiang and abandoned the Huai, swinging north to enter the sea through Shandong; flooded and leaderless districts fed the Nian rebellion.
summary_zh: 清廷困于太平天国战事，黄河在铜瓦厢决口，弃淮北徙，夺大清河经山东入海；受灾地区成为捻军根据地。

name: Xianfeng drought and locusts
summary: Drought and great locust swarms struck the Huai and lower Yangtze and reached the outskirts of Beijing, deepening famine in the war zones of the Taiping and Nian.
summary_zh: 大旱继以飞蝗蔽天，自江淮、江南直至京畿，太平军与捻军战区饥荒加剧。

name: Cholera in the Taiping war zone
summary: Cholera and other epidemics raged among soldiers and refugees crowded into Shanghai and the delta during the final Taiping campaigns, killing more than battle in some districts.
summary_zh: 太平天国后期，霍乱等疫病在上海及江南的军民、难民中流行，部分地区死于疫者多于死于兵。

name: Great Yangtze flood of 1870
summary: The highest Yangtze flood in centuries, recorded at Yichang, broke the Jingjiang dikes and opened the Songzi channel into Dongting Lake, permanently reshaping the middle river.
summary_zh: 宜昌出现数百年来最高洪水，荆江大堤溃决，冲开松滋口入洞庭湖，永久改变长江中游水系。

name: Dingwu Famine
toll_zh: 约九百万至一千三百万人死亡
summary: Three years of drought produced one of the deadliest famines in history; Shanxi alone lost about a third of its people, and missionary relief and foreign press coverage spurred new Chinese philanthropy.
summary_zh: 连续三年大旱，酿成世界史上最惨烈的饥荒之一，山西人口约减三分之一；传教士赈灾与报刊报道催生了新式义赈。

name: Zhengzhou breach
toll_zh: 约九十万至二百万人死亡
summary: The Yellow River broke at Zhengzhou and poured south into the Huai, flooding thousands of villages before the breach was closed in early 1889.
summary_zh: 黄河在郑州决口，南下夺淮，豫皖数千村庄被淹，至1889年初方合龙。

name: Bubonic plague in Guangzhou and Hong Kong
toll_zh: 广州约七万至十万，香港约二千五百人死亡
summary: Plague spreading from Yunnan reached Guangzhou and Hong Kong, where Yersin identified the bacillus; shipping carried this third pandemic around the world.
summary_zh: 鼠疫自云南传至广州、香港，耶尔森在港发现鼠疫杆菌；航运将这场第三次鼠疫大流行带往全球。

name: Floods and drought before the Boxers
summary: A Yellow River flood in Shandong in 1898 was followed by drought in 1899–1900; idle, hungry young farmers flocked to the Boxer movement, which blamed foreigners and Christians for the lack of rain.
summary_zh: 1898年山东黄河决口，继以1899—1900年大旱；无事可做的饥饿农民纷纷加入义和团，将天旱归咎于洋人与教民。

name: Central China famine
toll: Hundreds of thousands to several million dead (estimates vary widely)
toll_zh: 死亡数十万至数百万（估计差异很大）
summary: Floods followed by crop failure caused famine across Huaibei; international relief committees in Shanghai raised record sums, while the crisis fuelled anti-Qing unrest.
summary_zh: 江淮大水后颗粒无收，淮北大饥；上海华洋义赈会募款空前，社会动荡加剧反清情绪。

name: Yangtze and Huai floods of 1910–11
summary: Two years of floods and rice riots along the middle Yangtze, including the 1910 Changsha rice riot, left the region seething in the months before the Wuchang Uprising.
summary_zh: 长江中游连年大水，1910年长沙抢米风潮等民变迭起，民怨沸腾，随后爆发武昌起义。

name: Manchurian pneumonic plague
toll_zh: 约六万人死亡
summary: Pneumonic plague spread along the railways from Manzhouli to Harbin and beyond; Wu Lien-teh's quarantines, masks and cremations contained it and launched modern Chinese public health.
summary_zh: 肺鼠疫沿铁路自满洲里传至哈尔滨等地；伍连德推行隔离、口罩与焚尸，控制疫情，开创中国现代防疫。

name: Hai River flood of 1917
summary: Summer floods on the Hai River system submerged much of Zhili and Tianjin, displacing millions; Xiong Xiling's relief and river commission marked the start of modern water management in North China.
summary_zh: 海河水系大水，直隶与天津大片被淹，灾民数百万；熊希龄主持赈务并设顺直水利委员会，开华北近代治水之先。

name: North China famine of 1920–21
toll_zh: 约五十万人死亡，灾民二三千万
summary: Drought across five northern provinces left some 20–30 million destitute; foreign and Chinese relief agencies (later the China International Famine Relief Commission) held deaths far below 1877 levels.
summary_zh: 北方五省大旱，灾民二三千万；中外义赈团体（后成立华洋义赈会）救济，使死亡远低于丁戊奇荒。

name: Haiyuan earthquake
toll_zh: 约二十万至二十七万人死亡
summary: A magnitude ~7.8–8.5 earthquake in Haiyuan triggered vast loess landslides that buried whole villages, one of the deadliest quakes of the twentieth century.
summary_zh: 海原约8.5级大地震，黄土滑坡掩埋整村，为二十世纪最惨烈的地震之一。

name: Gulang earthquake
toll_zh: 约四万人死亡
summary: A magnitude ~7.7–8 earthquake shattered Gulang and Wuwei in the Hexi Corridor, compounding the misery of a region about to enter the 1928–30 famine.
summary_zh: 甘肃古浪约8级地震，古浪、武威等地城毁人亡，随后又陷入1928—1930年大饥荒。

name: Great Northwest drought
toll_zh: 估计死亡三百万至一千万人
summary: Years of drought, warlord requisitions and banditry produced famine across the northwest; Shaanxi's Guanzhong was devastated, and the famine fed the Feng Yuxiang–Chiang conflict and later Communist recruitment in the region.
summary_zh: 连年大旱加军阀征敛、匪患，西北大饥荒，关中尤惨；灾荒加剧冯玉祥与蒋介石之争，也为日后红军在西北立足埋下伏笔。

name: Central China floods of 1931
toll_zh: 死亡约四十二万至二百万以上（有争议）
summary: After a wet summer the Yangtze, Huai and Han flooded together, submerging Wuhan for months and displacing tens of millions; the Nanjing government's stretched relief came just as Japan seized Manchuria.
summary_zh: 长江、淮河、汉水同时泛滥，武汉被淹数月，灾民数千万；南京政府疲于赈灾之际日本发动九一八事变。

name: Yangtze and Han floods of 1935
toll_zh: 约十四万人死亡
summary: Torrential rain in the Han and middle Yangtze basins drowned large parts of Hubei and Hunan while the Red Army was on the Long March.
summary_zh: 汉江与长江中游暴雨成灾，湖北、湖南大片被淹，时值红军长征。

name: Huayuankou dike breach
toll_zh: 约四十万至八十九万人死亡，三四百万人流离
summary: Nationalist troops breached the Yellow River dikes to slow the Japanese advance; the river ran southeast into the Huai until 1947, creating the vast Yellow Flood Zone.
summary_zh: 国民党军为阻日军决开花园口大堤，黄河改道东南入淮直至1947年，形成黄泛区。

name: Henan famine
toll_zh: 约一百万至三百万人死亡，约三百万人逃荒
summary: Drought on top of war requisitions brought famine to Nationalist-held Henan; reports by Theodore White and others shamed Chongqing, and embittered peasants turned on retreating Nationalist troops during Operation Ichigo.
summary_zh: 旱灾叠加军粮征敛，国统区河南大饥荒；白修德等人的报道令重庆政府难堪，1944年豫湘桂战役中饥民反戈袭击溃退的国军。

name: Locust plagues of 1943–44
summary: Locust swarms followed the Henan famine across the North China Plain; in the Communist base areas mass anti-locust campaigns became a showcase of mobilisation.
summary_zh: 河南饥荒之后飞蝗遍及华北平原；中共根据地组织大规模扑蝗运动，成为群众动员的典范。

name: Guangdong famine
toll: Hundreds of thousands to ~3 million dead (estimates vary)
toll_zh: 死亡数十万至约三百万（估计不一）
summary: Drought, the Japanese blockade of rice imports and the cut-off of overseas remittances caused famine in Guangdong, with especially heavy deaths in Taishan and other emigrant counties.
summary_zh: 旱灾加之日军封锁米粮进口、侨汇断绝，广东大饥荒，台山等侨乡死亡尤重。

name: Huai River flood of 1950
summary: Severe floods on the Huai led Mao to order that 'the Huai River must be harnessed', launching the PRC's first great water-control campaign.
summary_zh: 淮河大水，毛泽东题词“一定要把淮河修好”，开启新中国首个大规模治水工程。

name: Yangtze and Huai floods of 1954
toll_zh: 官方统计约三万三千人死亡
summary: The largest Yangtze flood of the century forced the use of the Jingjiang flood-diversion zone and mass mobilisation to save Wuhan; it revived plans for a Three Gorges dam.
summary_zh: 本世纪长江最大洪水，启用荆江分洪区并全民动员保卫武汉；三峡建坝计划由此重提。

name: Great Chinese Famine
area: Nationwide, worst in Anhui, Sichuan, Henan, Gansu
toll_zh: 非正常死亡约一千五百万至四千五百万
summary: Great Leap Forward policies—grain procurement on inflated harvests, communal kitchens and diverted labour—turned poor weather into the deadliest famine in history; it led to Mao's partial retreat and the Lushan purge's legacy.
summary_zh: 大跃进的浮夸征购、公共食堂与劳力挪用，使不利天气演变为史上最惨烈的饥荒，迫使毛泽东退居二线。

name: Hai River flood of 1963
toll_zh: 官方统计约五千六百人死亡
summary: Record August rains flooded southern and central Hebei; Mao's call to 'harness the Hai River for good' launched a decade of dike and channel building.
summary_zh: 八月特大暴雨致冀中南大水，毛泽东题词“一定要根治海河”，此后十余年大修河道堤防。

name: Xingtai earthquake
toll_zh: 约8064人死亡
summary: A series of strong quakes struck Xingtai weeks before the Cultural Revolution; Zhou Enlai's visits and his call for earthquake prediction launched China's state seismology programme.
summary_zh: 文革前夕邢台连发强震；周恩来亲赴灾区并号召开展地震预报，中国地震工作由此起步。

name: Tonghai earthquake
toll_zh: 约一万五千六百人死亡
summary: A magnitude 7.1 quake devastated Tonghai county; amid the Cultural Revolution it was barely reported, and the toll was published only years later.
summary_zh: 通海7.1级地震，正值文革，当时几乎未作报道，死亡人数多年后才公布。

name: Haicheng earthquake
toll_zh: 约二千人死亡，远少于预期
summary: Foreshocks led officials to evacuate Haicheng hours before a magnitude 7.3 quake, often cited as the first successful earthquake prediction.
summary_zh: 前震促使当局在7.3级主震前数小时疏散民众，常被称为首次成功的地震预报。

name: Banqiao and Shimantan dam failures
toll: ~26,000 (official) to 240,000 incl. later famine and disease
toll_zh: 官方约二万六千人，连同后续饥疫或达二十余万
summary: Typhoon Nina's record rains overtopped and broke the Banqiao, Shimantan and dozens of smaller dams; the disaster was kept secret for years.
summary_zh: 台风“妮娜”带来特大暴雨，板桥、石漫滩等数十座水库垮坝，灾情长期保密。

name: Tangshan earthquake
toll_zh: 官方统计约二十四万二千人死亡
summary: A magnitude 7.6 quake levelled the industrial city of Tangshan; China refused foreign aid, and the disaster, read as an omen, preceded Mao's death and the fall of the Gang of Four.
summary_zh: 7.6级地震将工业城市唐山夷为平地；中国拒绝外援，民间视为天象异兆，随后毛泽东去世、四人帮倒台。

name: East China floods of 1991
toll_zh: 约二千人死亡
summary: Heavy rains flooded Anhui and Jiangsu; China appealed for international aid for the first time and launched new Huai and Tai lake control works.
summary_zh: 安徽、江苏特大水灾，中国首次呼吁国际救灾援助，随后加大治淮、治太工程。

name: 1998 Yangtze and northeast floods
toll_zh: 约三千至四千余人死亡
summary: Prolonged floods on the Yangtze and northeast rivers prompted a huge PLA deployment, a logging ban on upper-Yangtze forests and a grain-for-green programme.
summary_zh: 长江与东北松嫩流域洪水，解放军大规模抗洪；此后实施天然林禁伐与退耕还林。

name: SARS epidemic
toll: 349 dead in mainland China; 299 in Hong Kong
toll_zh: 内地349人、香港299人死亡
summary: A new coronavirus emerged in Guangdong and spread to Hong Kong, Beijing and abroad; early cover-ups cost Beijing's mayor and the health minister their posts and led to a new disease-reporting system.
summary_zh: 新型冠状病毒在广东出现并扩散至香港、北京及海外；早期隐瞒导致卫生部长、北京市长被免职，此后建立传染病直报系统。

name: Southern China snowstorms
toll_zh: 约129人死亡，受灾数千万人
summary: Freezing rain and snow brought down power lines and stranded millions of migrant workers travelling home for the Spring Festival, exposing the fragility of national infrastructure.
summary_zh: 冻雨暴雪压垮电网，春运期间数百万返乡农民工滞留，暴露基础设施的脆弱。

name: Wenchuan earthquake
toll_zh: 约六万九千人遇难，一万八千人失踪
summary: A magnitude 7.9 quake devastated Wenchuan, Beichuan and surrounding counties months before the Beijing Olympics; collapsed schools sparked public anger over shoddy construction.
summary_zh: 7.9级地震重创汶川、北川等地，正值北京奥运前夕；校舍倒塌引发对“豆腐渣工程”的公众愤怒。

name: Yushu earthquake
toll_zh: 约二千七百人遇难
summary: A magnitude 6.9 quake destroyed most of Jyekundo (Gyêgu), the Tibetan town at the heart of Yushu prefecture; the rebuilding reshaped the town.
summary_zh: 6.9级地震摧毁玉树州府结古镇大部，灾后重建改变了这座藏区城镇的面貌。

name: COVID-19 pandemic
toll: Official ~120,000 dead; excess-death estimates far higher
toll_zh: 官方约十二万人死亡，超额死亡估计远高于此
summary: A novel coronavirus first identified in Wuhan led to the city's lockdown and three years of 'zero-COVID' controls; protests in late 2022 preceded the abrupt end of restrictions and a deadly winter wave.
summary_zh: 新型冠状病毒首先在武汉发现，武汉封城，此后三年实行“动态清零”；2022年底抗议后政策骤然放开，冬季疫情致大量死亡。

name: Zhengzhou floods
toll_zh: 官方统计遇难失踪398人
summary: A record downpour flooded Zhengzhou's subway and road tunnels; an official inquiry later found local authorities had concealed deaths.
summary_zh: 特大暴雨淹没郑州地铁与隧道；国务院调查认定地方瞒报遇难人数。

name: Yangtze heatwave and drought
area: Sichuan, Chongqing and the Yangtze basin
summary: The most intense heatwave on record dried the Yangtze and Poyang Lake; hydropower shortfalls forced factory shutdowns in Sichuan.
summary_zh: 有记录以来最强热浪致长江与鄱阳湖水位骤降，四川水电不足、工厂限电停产。

name: Haihe floods of 2023
toll: Over 100 dead or missing in Beijing and Hebei
toll_zh: 京冀遇难失踪逾百人
summary: Typhoon Doksuri's rains caused the worst Haihe floods in decades; diversion of water into Hebei's flood-storage zones to protect Beijing and Xiong'an drew public criticism.
summary_zh: 台风“杜苏芮”带来暴雨，海河流域发生数十年来最大洪水；为保北京、雄安而启用河北蓄滞洪区引发争议。
